scope: Codemode shutdown request ordering, retaining prompt settlement and shared capacity until actual worker exit.

retainedExactCi.error: Two-worker admission limit reached during the unchanged six-image loop.

characterization.unsupportedEarlyTest: A proposed capacity-must-be-zero-at-result assertion failed, but source inspection proves Pi deliberately returns before actual exit. The newly proposed assertion was removed; all original tests/scenarios remain. That diagnostic log is retained and is not counted as a valid fail-first regression.
characterization.sourceProbeSetup: The first source cleanup await had no referenced Node handle after Worker.unref and exited 13. A bounded referenced timer now holds the probe alive until actual worker exit; corrected source probe exits 0.

implementation: Move process termination request out of Task.Run and perform it synchronously before Reap returns. Detached cleanup still awaits actual exit and bounded host/stderr cleanup.

Do not wait for actual process exit during settlement and do not increase/reset the two-worker limit or release capacity before exit. Existing cancellation/deadline/output/image/store/admission behavior is preserved.
sourcePaths: packages/codemode/src/runtime/host.ts: workerLauncher.stop invokes Worker.terminate before resolving; exit listener releases capacity.
packages/codemode/src/runtime/execution.ts: Execution.finish resolves after channel.stop without awaiting worker exit.
packages/coding-agent/src/extensions/codemode/execute.ts: shared two-worker admission and release callback.
limits: The controlled cleanup-pool barrier establishes the native/source request-order mismatch and its repair; the original CI log lacks scheduling/exit traces, so its exact failed interleaving is not proven.
The pending terminal keyboard/render difference and earlier quiet-startup/source calibration timing concerns remain separately open. Passing Codemode/resource suites do not resolve them.
